text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High TPM on model family sirocco11b in eu-west-1. Token/sec spikes -> GPU host saturation + 99th pct latency increase. Auto-scaling struggling, errors ~0.6% for hosted tier. Pager to eng-oncall.

maria: I'm on it — paging into #oncall-bridge. Did we get a tenant list?

incident-bot: Affected customers: small subset of hosted users pinned to sirocco11b; surge originated from a single tenant generating long-context chat. See brief metrics: cpu 92%, gpu mem 88%, kv-cache miss rate +40%.

samir: Can we do a quick per-model throttle? Recommend lowering TPM for sirocco11b to 30 tpm and RPM to 120 for hosted plan while we triage. Also consider disabling funcall for that family.

leo: +1 to throttles. I'll prepare the quota-change payload. Need oncall approval to push. @maria you good with those numbers?

maria: approve. Prioritize customer impact minimization: throttle first, then funcall off if errors persist. Notify CS about any tenant degradations.

leo: Executing now — running:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/quotas/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"model_family":"sirocco11b","overrides":{"hosted":{"tpm":30,"rpm":120}},"disable_features":["funcall"]}'
```
I'll watch rollout.

deploy-bot: QUOTA_UPDATE: rollout started for sirocco11b on prod/eu-west-1 by leo. Change id q_20260316_01.

leo: change applied to ~70% of hosts, telemetry shows immediate drop in incoming token rate. GPU saturation down to ~65%. Latency 99th trending down.

samir: Good. CS note drafted @natalie — pinging affected tenant owners with mitigation and ETA for full recovery.

natalie: thanks — I'll post an update on statuspage and open a customer DM thread for the top 3 tenants.

incident-bot: METRICS: 15m window after change: TPM -68%, errors down to 0.15%. KV-cache hits improving.

maria: plan for next 30m: monitor, if errors <0.2% and latency stable, we can experiment raising RPM by 10% increments. If any regression, roll back to previous throttle and consider temporary canary to sirocco10b fallback routing.

leo: adding automated rollback hook if errors exceed 0.5% for 5m. Command posted.

samir: also flagging that the long-context tenant should be rate-limited at the tenant layer; ops-next to pick up after handoff. @ops-next please own follow-up with infra tuning and tenant-specific carve-out.

ops-next: acknowledged, will take this for the 0800-1600 shift. I'll run a deeper profile and propose a longer-term quota policy for long-session workloads.

maria: handing off now to @ops-next + @leo. Action items: 1) keep throttles in place, 2) CS comms live, 3) investigate root cause of long-context runaway, 4) consider permanent fallback routing policy.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation applied (per-model quota change + funcall disable). Monitor window started.

maria: closing active pager for now, keeping thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
